Kake engineers are behind some of the world’s most innovative products (Brands you’ve heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45,000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!). We’re looking for **Senior QA Engineers** with strong experience in manual or automated testing, skilled in ensuring the quality of high-performance, scalable systems, and committed to quality best practices. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning quality end-to-end and collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to ship reliable, well-crafted software. **What you’ll build and own** * Design and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases. * Perform manual testing to identify functional, integration, usability, and edge-case issues. * Create, maintain, and improve automated test suites and testing frameworks. * Test web applications, APIs, and backend services for functionality, reliability, and performance. * Validate AI-generated code and features to ensure they meet quality, maintainability, and business requirements. * Investigate defects, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers on solutions. * Contribute to quality best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across projects. * Participate in requirement reviews and help identify risks early in the development process. **Core Requirements** * 5+ years of experience in **Quality Assurance** or **Software Testing.** * Strong experience with both manual and automated testing methodologies. * Experience testing web applications, APIs, mobile apps, and backend systems. * Hands-on experience with automation tools such as **Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, WebdriverIO** , or similar. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development
